name: Deals Create View collapses a toggled column and restores it after page reload
description:
Objective: Deals Create View collapses a toggled column and restores it after page reload.
Preconditions: Open Deals with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Deals.
2. Deals Create View collapses a toggled column and restores it after page reload.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The same data and state remain available after the reload or subsequent lookup.
